title.zh: 同一个核，方向为何不同

t.zh: 处理器能处理任意核，但课程公式和一些工具使用不同的核约定。对称平滑核掩盖了差别，现在用非对称核把问题显露出来，再给自己的处理器加上明确的数学接口。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The processor accepts any kernel, but conventions differ. Symmetric smoothing hides that difference. Expose it with an asymmetric kernel and build an explicit mathematical interface. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 对称核掩盖了方向差别；非对称核能区分数学卷积与互相关。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Symmetric kernels hide the orientation distinction; asymmetric kernels expose convolution versus correlation. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 接口接收数学卷积核。让非对称核的方向与卷积定义一致，保持输出尺寸和零边界。
brief.en: The interface receives mathematical convolution kernels. Match their orientation, including asymmetric kernels, with same-size output and zero boundaries.

naiveWhy.zh: 对称核不能区分两种约定；非对称亮点响应会暴露核的方向是否反转。
naiveWhy.en: Symmetric kernels hide the distinction; asymmetric impulse responses expose orientation.

hint.zh: 用非对称权重表与单个亮点检查方向。翻转核只调整权重表，不是翻转待处理图。
hint.en: Inspect an asymmetric kernel on an impulse. Reverse the weight table, not the image.

desc.zh: 翻转书写核后运行自己的互相关器，图外规则可设置。
desc.en: Reverse the written kernel and run your correlator with explicit borders.
